title: Answerthink® Receives UNITED VARS Global Collaboration Award
summary: We're proud to share that Answerthink®, a division of The Hackett Group®, has received the UNITED VARS Global Collaboration Award for exceptional use of the UNITED VARS global partner network to win a strategic SAP® S/4HANA implementation for a global manufacturer in the life sciences sector. The award recognizes a proactive approach that brought together partners across the UNITED VARS network during the sales process, helping demonstrate a seamless global delivery model from day one. This recognition reflects the power of collaboration, trusted partnerships and deep SAP expertise in helping organizations navigate complex global transformations. Congratulations to the entire Answerthink team on this achievement.
